reality.name: Sol-Prime Continuum
reality.description: The baseline universe anchor. Home to Sol, Aurelia, and the original Eventide Vault.

bodies.name: ANCHOR STAR
bodies.note: The stabilizing core of this universe. Double-click to enter Core Mode.

bodies.name: Cinder
bodies.note: Small, fast, scorched close to the light. A moment that burned bright and brief.

bodies.name: Veil
bodies.note: Under a permanent shroud of cloud. Where dreams stay unverified.

bodies.name: Aurelia
bodies.note: The inhabited one. Oceans, weather, city light on the dark side.

bodies.name: Rust
bodies.note: Half-finished terrain, dust storms, old machinery. Projects live here.

bodies.name: Goliath
bodies.note: A gas giant with a ring system and three moons. A whole chapter of life.

bodies.name: Mirror
bodies.note: Ice world, almost perfectly reflective. Someone I keep returning to.

bodies.name: Hollow
bodies.note: A small dwarf world, mostly unexplored. An idea waiting for a landing.

bodies.name: Wisp Nebula
bodies.note: A stellar nursery at the system edge. Ideas condense here before they become planets.

bodies.name: Eventide
bodies.note: A quiet black hole. The single storage and execution object of the universe — all digital matter lives here.

entries.title: First light on the water
entries.body:
I named this planet on a Tuesday. The oceans came first — I wrote the shoreline before I knew what the memory actually was.

Things to keep: the color of 6am, the train ticket, her exact wording.

entries.title: Weather report, interior
entries.body: Rained all day inside this memory. That is allowed — planets have weather, memories do too.

entries.title: The city on the dark side
entries.body: There is a city on Aurelia’s night side that only exists as light. I keep adding windows.

entries.title: A dream about staircases
entries.body: The staircase kept arriving before the building. Marble, then water, then just the idea of ascent.

entries.title: Second dream ledger
entries.body: Flying low over an ocean made of glass. Below it, another sky.

entries.title: Project: cartography engine
entries.body: Day 41. The contour generator finally stops lying about coastlines.

entries.title: Project: cartography engine — II
entries.body: Shipped the contour fix. The dust storm season on this planet is just me refusing to close tabs.

entries.title: Chapter nine: the ring system
entries.body: Every ring particle is a day. I counted for a while and stopped — that is the whole chapter.

entries.title: About M.
entries.body: Mirror reflects exactly what you bring to it. I brought a person.

entries.title: Idea: gravity as attention
entries.body: What you attend to gains mass. What gains mass bends the paths of everything near it.

entries.title: The afternoon that burned
entries.body: Some moments are short period, high temperature, forever close to the light.

entries.title: Recent: the archive decision
entries.body: Archived the 2018 pages today. A planet can keep its night side. That is not loss, that is rotation.

vault.content:
# Two Weeks Later: Reconstruction of the Village

**Timestamp:** Stardate +14 Days Post-Singularity  
**Location:** Eventide Outpost / Sector Sol-Prime  

Two weeks have passed since the reality drift destroyed the outer perimeter of the village. The initial shock waves collapsed the old data structures, but the community gathered at the central black hole horizon to begin rebuild efforts.

## Milestones Achieved
1. **Structural Foundations**: Rebuilt 14 solar-shielded living modules around the accretion ring.
2. **FileSystem Restoration**: Upgraded storage architecture to high-performance native Origin Private File System (OPFS) with IndexedDB fallback.
3. **Quantum Encryption**: Re-established isolated vault seals across all parallel realities.
4. **Communal Harmony**: The central pulse engine is back online at 99.8% stability.

*“From the ashes of collapsed data, we forge enduring structures.”*
